repo_notes.content: This repository is TypeScript-first. TypeScript owns memory behavior: domain types, SQLite/FTS schema and storage, routing, context packing, verification policy, the CLI bridge, tests, and pnpm/Turborepo orchestration. Python exists only as the thin Hermes adapter boundary.

V1 and V1.1 are local-first, evidence-first, and auditable. The implemented storage boundary is SQLite plus FTS, with append-only evidence, typed semantic facts, context packs, verification records, active session state, and workspace resources.

The core operating principle is event-sourced writes, multi-view storage, routed reads, and verified injection. Wiki pages should explain how writes preserve evidence first and how reads build bounded, cited context packs.

Preserve the V1/V2 boundary. Do not imply that vector databases, graph databases, cloud memory providers, LLM extraction, reflection, connector sync, handoff packets, branch drift checks, or citation validation are implemented in V1/V1.1.

The Hermes adapter has local smoke proof for the plugin boundary and CLI bridge only. Do not describe it as production Hermes runtime validation unless a real target Hermes checkout has loaded the plugin and exercised hooks and tools end to end.
